question: Which of the following places in India receive the highest rainfall?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mawsynram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mawsynram** is a village in the **East Khasi Hills district** of Meghalaya, India.
 
• It holds the record for being the **wettest place on Earth** with an average annual rainfall of about **11,871 millimeters** (467.4 inches).
 
• The heavy rainfall is mainly due to the **geographical location** and the presence of the **Bay of Bengal branch of the Indian monsoon.**
 
• The region's **topography** and **wind patterns** contribute to the high precipitation.
 
• Rainfall in Mawsynram is caused by the **orographic lift**, where moist air rises over the hills and cools down to release rain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Patna**__

 __
 
• **Patna** is the capital city of **Bihar** state in India.
 
• It is located on the southern bank of the **Ganges River**.
 
• Patna experiences a **humid subtropical climate** with moderate rainfall.
 
 
 
• **Guwahati**__
 __
 
• **Guwahati** is a major city in the **northeastern state of Assam**, India.
 
• It lies on the southern bank of the **Brahmaputra River**.
 
• Guwahati has a **tropical monsoon climate** and receives substantial rainfall but not as much as Mawsynram.
 
 
 
• **Imphal**__
 
 
• **Imphal** is the capital city of the **northeastern state of Manipur**, India.
 
• The city is situated in the **Imphal Valley**.
 
• Imphal has a **subtropical climate** with moderate to high rainfall, especially during the monsoon season.
